Figure 6. Rogersonin E (3) downregulated the expression of PD-L1 protein in tumor cells. A. MDA-MB-231 cells were treated with 2 mM
metformin, and 5 or 10 μM compound 3 for 24 h, followed by flow cytometry detection of cell surface PD-L1. The mean fluorescence intensity
(MFI) values of PD-L1 were shown on the right. B. MDA-MB-231 and A549 cells were treated with 5 or 10 μM 3 for 24 h, and the PD-L1 levels
were detected by immunoblotting with PD-L1 and GAPDH antibodies. The ratios of PD-L1 to GAPDH were calculated and shown below the
blots.
